customers.evidence: the Company helps its customers maximize value throughout the lifecycle of the reservoir

environment.evidence: Sustainability is at the core of the Company’s long-term success, and it is embedded throughout our business.

community.evidence: devoting time and resources to charitable causes

result.analyst_notes: Mostly factual, third-person 'the Company' voice with heavy business description. Sustainability and community appear as section headings with absolute, unhedged claims ('at the core', 'central to our corporate culture'). Customers get only a brief service aim. Employees, safety and governance are absent, and scale figures are stated without any value commitment.
